feature: ADR-0082 Linux cold run identity, worker argv and native sibling locator

linux.abi: local GNU C oracle verifies GRND_NONBLOCK/getrandom prototype plus prior native ABI; no RNG/device calls in C oracle

windows.scope: two portable builder tests need native Windows check; prior portable arguments/context/application native checks remain pending after unresolved automatic approval review quota failure; no new invocation attempted

limitations: Cold components are implemented but complete Linux host/Supervisor/signal/process-group/run-linux wiring remains incomplete.
RunIdentity uses kernel getrandom NONBLOCK and exact eight bytes, zero retry bound4/error immediate; no fallback. RNG values are not logged or asserted probabilistically unique.
Getter can still be manually reused; future host must generate once per new spawn. Random run ID is not cross-user authentication or own-virtual provenance.
Argv builder uses fixed OsStrings and strict parser; lexical validation is not native capability/consumer/neutral proof.

Locator requires canonical regular file and at least one execute bit, not effective ACL/mount access, ELF validation, signature or atomic image identity; deployment trust and actual spawn checks remain necessary.
Actual kernel RNG and owned private /tmp file/symlink metadata tested; no image execution, VT/evdev/uinput, Hook/SendInput or driver operation performed.
Additional unsafe is confined to eight-byte getrandom FFI; no dependency/lockfile changes.
Full objective including graphical providers, suspend/session control, advanced rules, hotplug/add, LED, hot configuration, GUI, packaging, Rust driver and companion audit remains incomplete.
